stem: How does the setting of the story “Grandfather’s Legacy” affect Manuel?

options.label: A
options.text: The setting of Oaxaca gives him an opportunity to learn something new about his family.

options.label: B
options.text: The setting of Oaxaca causes him to feel alone and completely out of place.

options.label: C
options.text: The setting of Grandfather’s garage allows him to feel a new sense of purpose in his life.

options.label: D
options.text: The setting of Grandfather’s garage provides him with materials to improve his creativity.
